gloss: make-ahead side dish; prepared dish kept on hand

definitions.gloss: make-ahead side dish; prepared dish kept on hand
definitions.explanation: Side dishes prepared in advance and stored in the refrigerator for several days. A practical approach to meal preparation, allowing busy people to have ready-made side dishes throughout the week.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{常備菜|じょうびさい}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: I make prepared side dishes on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {常備菜|じょうびさい}があると{毎日|まいにち}のお{弁当|べんとう}{作|づく}りが{楽|らく}になる。
examples.english: Having make-ahead dishes makes daily bento preparation easier.

examples.japanese: きんぴらごぼうやひじきの{煮物|にもの}は{定番|ていばん}の{常備菜|じょうびさい}だ。
examples.english: Kinpira gobo and simmered hijiki are classic make-ahead side dishes.

notes: Composed of {常備|じょうび} (always keeping on hand) + {菜|さい} (dish, vegetable). A key concept in Japanese home cooking ({家庭料理|かていりょうり}). Typical {常備菜|じょうびさい} include {切|き}り{干|ぼ}し{大根|だいこん} (dried daikon strips), きんぴらごぼう (braised burdock), and {煮豆|にまめ} (simmered beans). {常備菜|じょうびさい} recipes have become extremely popular online and in cookbooks, especially among working parents. Also called {作|つく}り{置|お}き (meal prep).
